verdict.rationale: Entrust IDV documents Watchlist reports that check applicants against sanctions, PEP, monitored-list and adverse-media watchlists. These reports sit alongside its Document and Facial Similarity reports under the same applicant and workflow API, so screening comes from the same vendor and API. The evidence does not show watchlist checks running inside the same workflow run, or hits being reviewed in a single dashboard or case surface, so full single-flow delivery is unproven. missing for 10: explicit evidence that watchlist reports run inside the same workflow run, a unified review surface for watchlist hits, ongoing monitoring details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface

citations.quote: Watchlist reports verify an applicant's records against a range of global watchlists, including: Sanctions... Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs)... Monitored Lists... Adverse Media
create an applicant → create a workflow run (returns an SDK token) → collect captures via SDK → retrieve results via webhook or polling
